CustomField.description: The American Testing Program (ATP) Code or College Entrance Examination Board (CEEB) Code is a 6-digit number that is used by standardized tests such as SAT and ACT. The first 2 digits indicate the state. The ATP Code is a 4-digit number for higher education institutions.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Represents the ATP or CEEB Code
CustomField.label: ATP Code
